COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
18.11.2024 CLR No. 118 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
After completion of the evidence of 
both the parties in SCC Suit No. 07 of 
2021, the revisionist-plaintiff had filed an 
Application to summon the Notary 
Advocate to prove the Agreement dated 
24.01.2021, executed between the 
revisionist-plaintiff and respondent no. 1 
and respondent no. 3-defendants, which 
has been dismissed by learned Additional 
District Judge, Kotdwar, District Pauri 
Garhwal vide impugned order dated 
07.10.2024. 
2. Heard Mr. Piyush Garg, learned 
counsel for the revisionist. 
3. Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate, has relied 
upon a judgment of the Hon’ble Supreme 
Court, passed in “Sugandhi (dead) by 
Lrs. and Another vs. P. Rajkumar rep. 
by His Power Agent Imam Oli (2020) 
10 SCC 706”.
4. Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate, further 
submitted that the SCC Suit is pending for 
final arguments. 
5. Notice are issued to the respondent  no. 1 to respondent no. 4 and respondent 
no. 5 (minor) through her natural 
guardian Imtiajuddin before Admission.
6. Steps to be taken within three days 
by all the permissible modes including 
dasti, as prayed. 
7. List on 17.12.2024. 
8. Till then, the further proceedings of 
SCC Suit No. 07 of 2021 are stayed. 
9. The Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 
2024) is disposed of accordingly. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 18.11.2024
Shiksha
